scope: Four 2D comparison concepts; no Meshy generation

variants.name: a-combined-direction
variants.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: Bara Kitchen capybara chef design comparison, 2D concept art rendered like a polished stylized 3D game character.
Subject: exactly one original upright capybara chef design shown twice, in two consistent views. Both views have anatomically CONNECTED shoulders, arms, wrists, hips, legs, and feet; absolutely no floating or detached hands, no missing arms or missing legs. Animal paws are smooth rounded mitten/bean shapes WITHOUT individual fingers, human thumbs, claws, or toe grooves. Bare small rounded animal feet.
Composition: landscape character design sheet on plain warm ivory background. Left 60 percent: large full-body front three-quarter view with the face turned slightly toward the viewer. Right 35 percent: slightly smaller full-body exact side profile of the IDENTICAL character, looking left, to make muzzle depth readable. Same neutral relaxed standing pose in both views, arms held slightly away from torso, empty paws, entire ears and feet visible. Generous clean margins, small soft ground shadows, no kitchen or props, no panel borders, no typography or labels.
Shared wardrobe and palette across the comparison: warm caramel/tan capybara, slightly darker broad muzzle, cream simple short-sleeve chef jacket with four small cocoa buttons, short cream waist apron, dark cocoa short bottoms ending above the bare feet. Keep the clothing compact and understated. No hat, no neck accessories, no footwear, no utensils, no extra decorative accessories, no tail. Calm friendly expression.
Lighting and finish: gentle even studio lighting, soft MATTE surfaces, broad clean colors, readable game-ready forms. No hyperrealistic fur, pores, glossy plastic, harsh specular highlights, human skin, or human hands. Clearly capybara, with small rounded ears and a broad blunt face; not a bear, horse, dog, or beaver.
Version A — our combined direction. Strongly cute, plump, compact game mascot. Height 2.1 head lengths excluding ears. Large round but subtly broad/rounded-rectangular capybara head, nearly half total height; broad cheeks, tiny rounded ears high on the head, almost no neck. A SHORT WIDE shallow muzzle, tiny two nostril marks, simple closed mouth, small dark relaxed expressive eyes. Muzzle projects at most one fifth of head depth in side view, never elongated or tapering. Small egg-shaped body, soft short connected arms, small mitten paws, short but clearly visible connected legs and round feet. Balance Overcooked's compact readable silhouette with a soft rounded Japanese-cute animal toy charm. More sculpted facial volume than a plush doll, much less anatomical than a realistic animal.

variants.name: d-refined-original
variants.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: our previous Bara Kitchen capybara concept. Preserve its recognizable capybara facial character, caramel and brown coloring, cream chef jacket/apron, and original gentle expression. Apply a MODERATE refinement rather than a complete style redesign: enlarge and round the head by about 25 percent relative to the body; shorten the muzzle projection substantially, especially in profile; shrink the torso and shorten legs for a plumper silhouette about 2.5 head lengths tall. Remove human hand anatomy completely: replace every hand with a smooth rounded animal mitten paw, no fingers, no human thumb. Simplify feet to rounded animal feet with no separate toe grooves. Keep arms and legs physically connected and visibly present. Reduce the realistic fur noise into soft broad matte surface shading while retaining more of the original sculpted cheek and muzzle shape than the other variants. It should remain clearly recognizable as a refinement of the reference.
